title: An edited ⌘J preset is what the chip sends
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData; in Settings › AI › Prompts edit Preset: Shorten to 'Make it much shorter.' and save
Write a two-line draft, select it and press Cmd-J
Choose Shorten, then reset the preset in Settings
expected: The version's instruction reads 'Make it much shorter.' After Reset to default, Shorten sends the shipped words again.
